name: oncology
description: Datenpaket für Onkologen: Laborwerte, Symptome, Gewicht, Medikamente, HR
description_en: Data package for oncology: lab results, symptoms, body composition, medications, HR

queries.lab_results: SELECT date, parameter, wert AS value, einheit AS unit, ref_min AS range_min, ref_max AS range_max, status, labor AS lab, kommentar AS notes FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.symptoms: SELECT date, symptom, value_num, value_text, category FROM symptoms WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.body_composition: SELECT ts, date, weight_kg, bmi, body_fat_pct, muscle_pct, source FROM body_composition WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.medications: SELECT ts, date, drug_name, dose_value, dose_unit, route, notes FROM medications WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.daily_vitals: SELECT date, sleep_hr_avg AS hr_avg, resting_hr_bpm AS hr_resting, hrv_rmssd_ms, spo2_avg_pct AS spo2_avg, resp_rate_avg AS respiration_avg, sleep_duration_min AS total_sleep_min, steps FROM daily_context WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
